plugins.name: founder-toolkit
plugins.description: Your AI co-founder suite — ROI calculator, market intel, GTM playbook, pitch prep, investor agent, and social marketing for founders and solopreneurs.

skills.name: cofounder:gtm-playbook
skills.description: Use when planning go-to-market strategy — networking, industry access, LinkedIn, conferences, content strategy, partnerships, outreach. Answers "how do I get known?" and "how do I get meetings?
skills.description_zh: 规划市场拓展中的人脉、行业接入、LinkedIn、会议内容、合作和触达，帮助提升知名度与获取会面。

skills.name: cofounder:market-intel
skills.description: Use when analyzing customer segments, market sizing, competitor analysis, or pricing strategy for ProduceGerX. Answers "who should I target?" and "how does the market look?
skills.description_zh: 为ProduceGerX分析客户细分、市场规模、竞品和定价战略，确定目标与市场环境。

skills.name: cofounder:pitch-prep
skills.description: Use when preparing for a client meeting, investor pitch, or demo. Builds a custom prep package with client profile, ROI arguments, objection handling, pricing proposal, and meeting script. Invoke before any important meeting.
skills.description_zh: 在重要客户会面、路演或演示前，定制客户资料、ROI论点、异议应对、报价和会议脚本。

skills.name: cofounder:roi-calculator
skills.description: Use when calculating ROI, unit economics, CAC, LTV, break-even, runway, cash flow, or pricing scenarios for ProduceGerX. Answers "is this viable?" and "what happens if we charge X?
skills.description_zh: 为ProduceGerX计算ROI、单位经济、CAC/LTV、盈亏平衡、资金跑道、现金流或定价情景，评估可行性。

skills.name: cofounder
skills.description: Use when the user asks any business strategy question — ROI, pricing, market analysis, networking, pitch prep, or general business advice. Routes to the right co-founder sub-skill or answers directly.
skills.description_zh: 回答ROI、定价、市场、人脉、路演或一般商业战略，路由至合适的联合创始人子技能或直接分析。

skills.name: cost-reducer
skills.description: Use when reviewing infrastructure costs, optimizing API spend, reducing cloud bills, or before adding new paid service integrations. Triggers on high OpenAI/Twilio/Supabase usage, DALL-E generation, embedding indexing, or storage egress concerns.
skills.description_zh: 审查基础设施和API成本、优化云账单或新付费集成前支出，涵盖OpenAI/Twilio/Supabase、图片生成、嵌入及存储出站。

skills.name: investor-agent
skills.description: Use when preparing pitch decks, investor materials, financial projections, fundraising strategy, market sizing, competitive analysis, or when the user asks about raising capital, valuation, term sheets, or investor outreach for ProduceGerX.
skills.description_zh: 为ProduceGerX准备路演、投资者资料、财务预测、募资策略、市场竞争分析及估值条款与投资者触达。

skills.name: social-marketing
skills.description: Use when planning social media content, writing posts, building content calendars, crafting ad copy, planning LinkedIn/Instagram/TikTok campaigns, growing audience, or promoting ProduceGerX to HR managers and event planners.
skills.description_zh: 规划社交内容、帖子日历、广告与LinkedIn/Instagram/TikTok活动，增长受众并向HR及活动策划者推广ProduceGerX。
